camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeDnsFirewallPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Destination '10.2.XX.XX/24' --SourceIp '140.205.118.XXX' --Description test --PageSize 10 --CurrentPage 1 --IpVersion 4 --AclAction accept --Lang zh --AclUuid 'b6c8f905-2eb6-442a-ba35-9416e0000' --Source '192.0.XX.XX/24' --Release true
description_en: Queries the list of access control lists (ACLs) for the DNS firewall
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-dns-firewall-policy --source-ip 140.205.118.XXX --lang zh --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --source 192.0.XX.XX/24 --destination 10.2.XX.XX/24 --description test --acl-action accept --release true --acl-uuid b6c8f905-2eb6-442a-ba35-9416e0000 --ip-version 4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDnsFirewallPolicy

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The language of the response messages. Valid values: zh (Chinese) and en (English)
parameters.help_zh: 请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：-zh：中文-en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The source address in the DNS firewall policy. Fuzzy match is supported.

The value of Source can be a CIDR block or an address book
parameters.help_zh:
DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略中的访问源地址。支持使用模糊查询。

Source可以是单个CIDR地址或地址簿名称
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The destination address in the DNS firewall policy. Fuzzy match is supported.

The value of Destination can be a CIDR block, a domain name, or an address book
parameters.help_zh:
DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略中的目的地址。支持模糊查询。

Destination可以是单个CIDR地址或域名，也可以是地址薄名称
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en: The description of the DNS firewall policy
parameters.help_zh: DNS边界防火墙策略的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The action that is performed on traffic that hits the DNS firewall policy. Valid values:

accept: allows the traffic.

drop: denies the traffic.

log: monitors the traffic.

If you do not specify this parameter, policies of all action types are queried
parameters.help_zh:
DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略中设置的访问流量通过云防火墙的方式（动作）。取值：

accept：放行
drop：拒绝
log：观察

不设置该参数表示查询所有动作
parameters.name: acl_action

parameters.help_en:
The status of the access control policy. The policy is enabled by default after it is created. Valid values:

true: enables the access control policy.

false: disables the access control policy
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。策略创建后默认启用该策略。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略

false：不启用访问控制策略
parameters.name: release

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the firewall rule
parameters.help_zh: 防火墙规则的唯一标识id
parameters.name: acl_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The IP version that is supported. Valid values:

4: IPv4

6: IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
支持的IP地址版本。取值：

4：代表IPv4地址
6：代表IPv6地址
parameters.name: ip_version
